अकृतिन् [akṛtin], a. [न. त.] Not skilful or clever, clumsy, awkward; unfit for doing anything.

अकृपण [akṛpaṇa], a. [न. त.] Not wretched, not miserly.

अकृश [akṛśa], a. [न. त.] Not slender or weak, full, entire, strong. -Comp. -अश्वः N. of a king of Ayodhyā. -लक्ष्मीa. endowed with full prosperity. -क्ष्मीः great splendour or property; अकृशमकृशलक्ष्मीश्चेतसा शंसितं सः
